summary: Ansible validates with the aac-tools toolchain (Jenkinsfile.architecture and the architecture gate; scripts/arch-validate.py deleted; b92d01a, gate green). The carrier set is 28 repos, with gitblit and complete GitHub trees in agreement. The 27 other carriers are assigned in P11–P13b and in the ledger: KitchenDisplay moves to P11 because its deploy job is disabled, FieldnotesApp goes to P12b, and P12c guards IoTSupport, whose AaC build has been red since 2026-09-24 (close-out B2).
